selection: Choose only necessary roles, respect runtime capacity, and assign disjoint write ownership.

runbooks.trigger: A new or revised SwiftUI product behavior
runbooks.deliverable: Native behavior with acceptance evidence, build results and relevant captures

runbooks.trigger: Presence, ownership, model access, service delivery or context handoff
runbooks.deliverable: Swift contracts and integrations with real service receipts and failure recovery

runbooks.trigger: A reproducible regression or CI failure
runbooks.deliverable: Small verified correction and exact regression evidence

runbooks.trigger: Uncertain API, SDK, provider or infrastructure support
runbooks.deliverable: Primary sources, bounded experiment, supported decision and explicit limitations

runbooks.trigger: A substantial outcome spanning independent modules
runbooks.deliverable: Dependency plan, exclusive ownership, verified handoffs and integrated behavior

runbooks.trigger: Onboarding, documentation, developer tooling or measured workflow friction
runbooks.deliverable: Accurate executable setup or workflow improvement with observed results

runbooks.trigger: Document export, evidence navigation or relationship indexing
runbooks.deliverable: Provenance-preserving Swift data flow and accessible presentation

runbooks.trigger: A focused refinement to native feedback, motion or microcopy
runbooks.deliverable: Purposeful native feedback verified with reduced-motion and accessibility behavior
